Line 46 uses `text.substring(0, borderLength)` to truncate text that may contain ANSI color codes (as stated in the BorderTextOptions comment on line 10: 'Pre-rendered string with ANSI color codes'). Substring truncates by character count, not visual width, which will split ANSI escape sequences and produce invalid output. The function should use `stringWidth` (available at line 6) to ensure truncation respects visual width like the rest of the function does.
